title: Qadam Qadam Pa Banayi Hai Karbala Zainab
body:
Qadam qadam pe banayi hai Karbala Zainab, sahara bante gaye tere naqsh-e- pa Zainab
Khuda ke deen ko goodi mein paalne waali, pahaad jaisi museebat ko taalne waali, nabuwwat aur imamat sanbhalne waali, yazidiyyat ki sinaa ko nikaalne waali, qadam qadam pe banayi hai Karbala Zainab
Museebaton mein aseeri pasand kar ke rahi, dil-e-quloos wafa dard mand kar ke rahi, dare yazid hamesha ko band kar ke rahi, hussainiyat ke alam ko buland kar ke rahi, qadam qadam pe banayi hai Karbala Zainab
Dayareshaam mein taqreer charsu Zainab, nigahe azmat-e-islaam qibla ru Zainab, sar-e-Hussain se jab ki thi guftagu Zainab, laho mein doobi hui thi rag-e-gulu Zainab, qadam qadam pe banayi haikarbala Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Atash se neahar ki dharaon ko moud aayi hain, haryat o maut ke rishtey ko joud aayi hain, kaleja gham se bhateja ka todh aayi hain, yeh laash bhai ki muqtal mein chod aayi hain, qadam qadam pe banayi hai Karbala Zainab
Zubaan-e-khushk pa shikwa na tha muqaddar ka, Sakina goad mein aur dil mein daagh Akbar ka, tha saamna bhi to zulm-e-jafa ke khanjar ka, lahad thi saamne jhoola nahin tha Asghar ka, qadam qadam pe banayi hai Karbala Zainab
Aseer hoke har ek gham utha ke ayi hain, khuda ke deen ki manzil bana ke ayi hain, shahadaton ke natije bata ke ayi hain, ye apne qutbaon se Kufa hila ke ayi hain, qadam qadam pe banayi hai Karbala Zainab...
